tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gong chos ye shes rnam rgyal gyi ngor mdzad kyai rdor bdag bskyed dang kha rag ma'i gsol mchod bzhugs so// na mo gu ru he badz+ra ya/ 'gro rnams sgrol 'dod bsam pa yis/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /shes rab snying brtse dang bcas pas/ /brtson pas sems can don du bdag /sangs rgyas mdun du gnas byas te/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed bgyi/ /lan gsum/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng / /sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ mtshan las/ /rab 'phros rdo rje sa gzhi dang / /rwa drwa gur dang bla bre me/ /srung 'khor dbus su pad nyi dang / /bdud bzhi'i gdan steng sangs rgyas mtshan/ /a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ e ai o au aṃ a/ tshar gnyis brjod/ yongs gyur zla ba me long ye/ /dpe byad brgyad cu'i rang bzhin gyi/ /ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha ṇa/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ ya ra la ba ḍa dha/ yongs gyur nyi ma mnyam nyid ye/ /zla nyi'i bar du thod pa'i dpral/ /sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ mtshan g.yon/ /gri gug aṃ mtshan sor rtog ye/ /de kun gcig gyur bya grub ye/ /de las chos ye rang nyid ni/ /dges rdor sngon po zhal brgyad pa/ /dbus sngo g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dang / /steng du lhag zhal gnyis gnyis nag /spyan gsum mche gtsigs smar smin skra/ /dmar ser gyen brdzes phyag bcu drug /thod nang g.yas dang glang chen dkar/ /g.yon dang sa lha ser po dang / /g.yas gnyis nas bzung bdun pa'i bar/ /rta sngo bong ga glang ser dang / /rnga mong thal kha mi dmar dang / /sha ra bha sngo byi bla gwa /g.yon gnyis nas bzung bdun pa'i bar/ /chu lha dkar dang me lha dmar/ /rlung lha ljang dang zla ba dkar/ /nyi dmar gshin rje sngon po dang / /nor 'dzin ser po'i phyag mtshan can/

/thod pa skam thod rlon do shal/ /phyag rgya drug can zhabs bzhi pa/ /g.yas gnyis brkyang brlar g.yon bskum gyi/ /sor mo gtod pa'i gar stabs can/ /gar dgu'i nyams ldan pang na yum/ /bdag med sngon mo zhal gcig ma/ /spyan gsum phyag gnyis g.yas gri gug /mkhar 'phyar g.yon na thod khrag gis/ /yab 'khyud skra ser gyen brdzes shing / /thod skam thod dang do shal can/ /phyag rgya lngas spras g.yon brkyang dang / /g.yas bskum yab dang mnyam sbyor sku/ /me dpung dbus bzhugs skye mched drug /gti mug zhe sdang ser sna 'dod/ /phrag dog bdag med lha mos mtshan/ /gnas gsum sku gsung thugs rdo rje/ /lha mos mtshan pa'i thugs 'od kyis/ /ye shes spyan drangs dgug gzhug bcing / /dbang gyur gau rī sogs kyis mdzad/ /dbang lha spyan drangs bskur gsol gyis/ /dbang bskur mi bskyod rgyas btab thugs/ /pad nyir yab hūm̐ yum aṃ mthar/ /so so'i sngags bskor dmigs bzlas bya/ /oṃ aṣ+ṭā na nā ya piṅga lod+dhā ke sha bad+dhā mā ne/ tsa turbing+sha ti ne trā ya/ ṣo ḍa sha bhu dzā ya/ kṛṣ+ṇa dzī mū ta ba pu ṣe/ ka pā la mā la a ne kān dha ri ṇe/ at+mā ta/ krū ra tsit+t+ra ya/ ar+dhen+tu daṃṣ+ṭi ṇe/ oṃ mā ra ya/ mā ra ya/ kā ra ya/ kā ra ya/ gardza ya gardza ya/ tardza ya ta rdza ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ sap+ta sā ga ran/ ban+dha ban+dha nā ga aṣ+ṭa kān/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ sha trūn/ ha hā hi hī hu hū he hai ho hau haṃ haḥphaṭa swāhā/ zhes nyer gcig sogs/ oṃ de ba pi tsu badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra kat+t+ra ri he badz+ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes sngags tshan gnyis gsum sogs/ oṃ a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ e ai o au aṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥ.aṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥnaṃ badz+ra nai rārma ya hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes ci rigs bzlas mthar phreng ba thal mo'i bar du bzung la/ bde gshegs sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

/phyag chen kyai yi rdo rje'i sku/ /myur du 'grub par byin rlabs gsol/ /zhes spyi bor phreng ba bzhag rang gi zhal phyag zhabs lhag yum/ /rtsa ba'i zhal phyag zhabs thim pas/ /rang nyid he ru ka zhal gcig /phyag gnyis sku can nyid du gyur/ /skye mched gnas gsum lha rnams gsal/ /snod bcud kyai yi rdo rje yi/ /rten dang brten gyur longs spyod kun/ /mchod pa'i ngo bo rnam par dag /dge 'di'i gnas skabs sngags spyod dang / /myur du spang gnyen ro gcig gyur/ /bkra shis don kun grub gyur cig /ces 'di sa skya kun blo la/ /gong chos ye shes rnam rgyal gyis/ /bskur ngor rang bzhed ji bzhin bris/ /dge des 'gro kun dges rdor gyur/ /yang gcig kha rag khyung btsun mar/ /sger gsol sha chang chos sman rnams/ /lhan sbyar gtor ma mkhar thabs steng / /dmar gtor gru gsum rgyan mdzes mthar/ /sman rag phud skyems gser g.yu sbran/ /dkar dmar skyems dang nyer mchod lnga/ /spos dud mda' dar sna lnga bshams/ /skyabs gsum rtsa gsum bdag skyabs mchi/ /sems can don du rta mgrin gyur/ /chos nyid ngang las rang rta mchog /zhal gsum phyag drug dmar ljang dkar/ /g.yas gsum rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ gri/ /g.yon gsum sdigs mdzub mdung rgyu zhags/ /dur khrod dpal chas kun rdzogs shing / /zhabs brgyad g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gis/ /klu brgyad sbrul gyi rnam par brdzis/ /zhal gdangs mche gtsigs spyan gsum bgrad/ /skra brdzes rta mgo gsum skad kyis/ /snang srid dbang sdud me phung gi /sa gzhi rwa ba bla bre gur/ /lus kun rang 'dra'i khro gtams kyis/ /zhal nas sngags sgras gnod kun bsregs/ /oṃ hrīḥpad+ma ta kṛta badz+ra kro dha ha ya gṛ ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ci 'grub bzlas mthar/ kha rag ma'i mchod gtor la dmigs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ tṛ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ tṛ rat+na trai lo kya phaṭa/ ces pas byin gyis brlabs/

oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā shrī he ru ka hūṃ phaṭa/ hoḥ dmar mo khro gnyer can bu mo/ /mched bzhi khyad par kha rag ma/ /pham phab bzhis dang phrin las phyir/ /da lta gshegs shig brtse gdung can/ /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbadz+ra ḍā ki ni/ e a ra li hriṃ hriṃ hriṃ/ kha rag ma'i zhal du/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ ma hā ba lin+ta khā hi/ bod skyong bstan ma bcu gnyis las/ /gnod sbyin mo mched kha rag mar/ /slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /gsang mtshan rgyan cha zhon bcas gnang / /sngon dam bzhin du bskul ba ni/ /bran gos rgyan bcas thugs dam bskul/ /'dir byon mchod gtor bzhes nas kyang / /bstan 'gro bdag bcas spyi bye yi/ /phrin las myur mdzod sa mā ya/ /bdag bskyed kyi sngags gsum tsam mthar/ oṃ badz+ra ma ti hūm̐/ zhes ci nus bzlas mthar/ mchod gtor rnams gtsang sar 'bul ba dang chab cig hoḥ bod skyong chen mo bcu gnyis las/ /gnod sbyin mched gras kha rag mas/ /dpal chen po dang pad+ma'i bka'/ /ji ltar bsgos bzhin bsgrub mdzod la/ /mchog thun dngos grub rang skal bzhin/ /myur du stsol cig ma gcig kye/ /zhes gtor ma btang ngo / /rang gi gnas gsum 'bru gsum mtshan/ /dge des rta mgrin 'grub pa dang / /'phral yun bkra shis char ltar phob/ /ces 'di sa skya kun blo yis/ /gong bskul rjes 'brel nyid du bris/ /bstan mas rjes brtses bskyangs nas su/ /bde chen ye shes 'grub gyur cig/ // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ kye rdor bdag bskyed dang kha rag ma'i gsol mchod PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
